title: Simulation 3D Motorcycle
text: Implement motorcycle in 3D environment, 3 inputs, {Type} sets Type Sports; {Color}, {Name}, {Sample time}, {Enable light controls, VehLightsControl} controls vehicle lights, {Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor} sets the headlight color, {High beam intensity, HighBeamIntensity}, {Low beam intensity, LowBeamIntensity}, {High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle}, {Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle}, {Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation} sets the left headlight beam orientation, {Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation} sets the right headlight beam orientation, {Brake light intensity, BrakelightIntensity}, {Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity}, {Period, SignallightPeriod} sets the turn signal light period, {Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth}, {Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} sets the motorcycle initial translation zeros and {Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} sets the motorcycle initial rotation zeros. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Light controls
ports.summary: Vehicle lights on or off 1-by-5 vector

params.name: Type
params.values: Type Sports bike (default) | Motor bike | Scooter

params.name: Color
params.values: Color of vehicle Red (default) | Orange | Yellow | Green | Blue | Black | White | Silver | Dazzle Camouflage

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of motorcycle SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor
params.values: Headlight color [1,1,1] (default) | 1-by-3 vector of RGB triplet values

params.name: High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle
params.values: High beam cone half angle 1.22 (default) | positive scalar less than pi/2

params.name: Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle
params.values: Low beam cone half angle 1.22 (default) | positive scalar less than pi/2

params.name: Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation
params.values: Left headlight beam orientation [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 vector greater with values between -pi and pi

params.name: Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation
params.values: Right headlight beam orientation [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 vector greater with values between -pi and pi

params.name: Period, SignallightPeriod
params.values: Turn signal light period 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth
params.values: Pulse width 50 (default) | positive scalar less than 100

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
